name: Hardware-Splicer
pitch_50: Hardware-Splicer lets general-purpose AI agents perform bounded hardware-engineering work while deterministic constraints, provenance-bearing evidence, exact revision state, and scoped human authority prevent model confidence from silently becoming physical truth.
description: Hardware-Splicer is model-independent infrastructure for auditable agentic hardware engineering. The canonical candidate now includes a document-grounded Astra engineering run, deterministic SPI-flash adapter reference design, production artifact set, guarded host test software, and a remote functional-test evidence contract. Deterministic constraints, project/revision state, provenance-bearing evidence, physical-proof records, and scoped human authorization remain independently authoritative.
limitations: The canonical package is PACKAGED_NOT_PHYSICAL. Provider engagement, fabrication, assembly, power-on, bench measurement, physical correctness, industrial economics, and production readiness are not claimed. Software, MCP, CAD, DRC/ERC, modeled, or package-integrity evidence is not physical proof. Hardware-Splicer does not claim universal hardware correctness, zero hallucination, autonomous certification, or replacement of a qualified hardware engineer.
